note_en: 才 after a time expression means "only then, not until" and signals that something took longer or was harder than expected: 花了差不多两个小时才把它从头设置好 "it took me almost two hours to get it all set up from scratch." Its opposite is 就, which signals speed or ease. Note the word order: the time comes first, then 才, then the verb, the reverse of English "I didn't finish until..."
